component.name: OpenSCCT Godot
component.summary: A community rewrite of Chaos Theory Versus

description.p: OpenSCCT recreates spies versus mercenaries using Godot and C#. This experimental native Linux port includes controller support, offline bots, multiplayer and optional community maps.
Use the native OpenSCCT launcher to build the original maps and game assets from your installed Steam copy of Chaos Theory. This fan project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft.
